title: Peanut Butter Cup Brownie Swirl
description: This makes a total of 9 servings of Peanut Butter Cup Brownie Swirl. Each serving comes out to be 176 calories, 16.3g fats, 2.3g net carbs, and 4.1g protein.

instructions.text: Gather all ingredients. Spray an 8 x 8 baking pan with cooking spray. Preheat oven to 350F. Melt peanut butter and butter together in microwave for 30 seconds, then add sweetener from Swirl list and combine. Set aside.

In a bowl or food processor, combine sweetener, cocoa powder, almond flour, and salt. Melt butter in microwave, then add to flour mixture and combine. Add eggs and half & half. Combine everything well. Pour into prepared pan.
Put dollops of peanut butter mix on top of the brownie mix. Take a knife and swirl the peanut butter through the chocolate. Sprinkle the top lightly with salt. Bake for 20 minutes.
Remove from oven and set on a cooling rack. Cool completely before serving, for best flavor.
